items.title: 13.11.3 Disinfection par asar dalne wale awamil (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.11.3, printed pages 301-302.

items: pH: taqreeban 6 se 7.5 pH par HOCl ghalib hota hai aur disinfection sab se moassar; 7.5 se oopar OCl- ghalib hota hai, kam moassar magar phir bhi disinfect karta hua.
Chlorine ki dose: jitni zyada chlorine, disinfection utni moassar; bacteria maarne ke liye kaafi HOCl aur OCl- dene ko kaafi chlorine dalni chahiye.
Contact time: pani chlorine ke saath itni der rahe ke disinfectants bacteria, viruses aur protozoa mein ghus kar unhen maar sakein.

blocks.caption: Awamil
rows: disinfectants ko bacteria, viruses, protozoa mein ghusna hai

blocks.prompt: Pani ke disinfectant ke taur par chlorine ke kimiyai usool muadlon ke saath wazeh karein, aur us par asar dalne wale awamil ginwayein (exercise Q.2k; Quick Check 13.6b).
blocks.explanation: Chlorine hydrolyse hoti hai, Cl2 + H2O se HCl + HOCl, aur HOCl juzvi taur par H+ + OCl- mein ionise hota hai; neutral HOCl microbial cells mein dakhil hota hai aur dono species proteins, enzymes aur nucleic acids ko oxidise kar ke jaraseem maarti hain. Asar pH (6 se 7.5 par HOCl ghalib), chlorine ki dose, aur contact time par munhasir hai.

items: Disinfection pH (6-7.5 par HOCl sab se moassar, 7.5 se oopar OCl-), chlorine ki dose aur contact time par munhasir hai.
